notes.title: July 31 update: Special Skills added to Battle Mode
notes.content:
Special Skills have been added to Battle Mode. These are the same skills that you learn in the Story Mode, but it is not necessary to have unlocked them in the Story to be able to use them in Battle Mode.

Toggle the "Special Skills" switch in the lobby, then continue to the next screen to select your Disc (upper row) and Movement (lower row) skills. Disc skills can be used in battle mode using the Y button (on game controller) or E key (on keyboard). Movement skills can be used with the B button (on game controller) or right-click (on mouse).

Please enjoy duking it out with your friends using these special skills!

notes.title: 29th May 2023 Update
notes.content:
29th May 2023: Added a new mini-game, [b]Nice Disc Striker[/b]!
2v2 team battle where you try to take out the opposing team's mascot with your hot discs!!
Choose Nice Disc Striker from the Battle Mode screen.

notes.title: 14th May 2023 Update
notes.content:
May 14, 2023: New mini-game Nice Disc Run has been added to celebrate the release!
Choose it from the Battle Mode screen. It is a one-on-one racing game.

If you play alone, you will be playing against a bot. In the race, of course, you can throw discs and interfere with your opponent. 

In addition to the above updates, we have also added fighting sticks as a compatible controller.
